tts: This program uses Python's math library to work out how many strips to give.
The comment says what the program does.
import math brings in Python's math module. It comes with Python, so there's nothing to install.
The patient needs forty-five tablets.
Each strip has ten tablets.
Forty-five divided by ten is four point five. But you can't give half a strip.
math dot seal rounds up to the next whole number. So the pharmacist gives five strips.
This line imports only the square root tool, so it can be used without writing math and a dot.
The square root of eighty-one is nine. Python shows it as nine point zero.

tts: In the terminal, the student types: pip install numpy.
pip finds NumPy on PyPI, the online library of Python packages.
It downloads NumPy and installs it on the computer.
Now any program on this computer can use it, with import numpy as np.
And pip uninstall numpy removes it again.

tts: Terminal में student type करता है: pip install numpy।
pip, NumPy को PyPI पर ढूँढता है, जो पाइथन packages की online library है।
यह NumPy download करके computer पर install कर देता है।
अब इस computer का कोई भी program इसे use कर सकता है, import numpy as np से।
और pip uninstall numpy इसे फिर से हटा देता है।
